title: Atlantic Tide: Come to Bed With Me? 8 Hours of Ocean Waves for Sleep
description:
Come to bed with me? The Atlantic, from a bright turquoise afternoon through sunset to dusk under the palms, all slowly fading to pure black by twenty minutes so nothing lights up your room. Then it's just the waves for eight hours.

Slow waves rolling in and washing back over a deep, low ocean bed. No gulls, no music, no talking, nothing that jumps out at you. The surf never loops: every wave is generated fresh by Sandoval Studios. Photos shot on Florida's Atlantic beaches.

REST. DIGEST. Goodnight.
